_comment: F67 — the vetted non-custodial wallet list shown at onboarding Step 1. Each wallet is self-custodial (the member holds their own keys/seed phrase; no wallet here holds funds on the member's behalf). Reviewed each equinox — links, store IDs, and the set of wallets are re-checked twice a year (around 20 March and 22 September) and any wallet that has turned custodial, unmaintained, or hostile to Solana is removed. Order here is NOT the display order: WalletChooser shuffles uniformly on every load so no wallet holds a permanent first position (Tradition T6 — no endorsements).

wallets.name: Solflare
wallets.note: Solana-native; extension, mobile, and hardware-wallet support.

wallets.name: Glow
wallets.note: Solana wallet; iOS app + browser extension. No Android build at last review.

wallets.note: Solana-native mobile wallet from Jupiter. Mobile only (no extension).
